nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=68 beats='Tomas and his grandmother Lola unpack her sewing box on the porch. The spring festival is tomorrow. Lola shows Tomas a bamboo frame and a bolt of yellow silk. Tomas remembers last years kite that tore in a gust. Lola says the wind has its own ideas, so a kite must be ready to change. A wind chime tinkles.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='The porch table is covered with spools of thread and scraps of colored paper. Lola asks Tomas what shape he imagines flying high above the festival crowd. Tomas pictures a big steady diamond and a quick little box. Lola says both shapes fly differently and asks him to choose one to start.'>>

choices.label: Build a big diamond kite
Build a quick box kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Lola smiles and cuts the yellow silk into a large diamond. Tomas pastes the edges with flour glue while Lola ties the bamboo cross-spars with red thread. The diamond kite looks grand and steady. Tomas imagines it floating high above the festival field. The sun warms their hands.'>>

choices.label: Take it to the field now
Add a long ribbon tail first

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Lola finds a diagram in an old book. Together they fold the silk into a small box shape and glue six short bamboo rods across the corners. Tomas holds the tight little frame up to the light. It looks quick and nimble, hardly bigger than his hand. The chime tinkles again.'>>

choices.label: Paint racing stripes on it
Try it in the yard now

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas and Lola carry the big diamond kite to the green field. Banners flap in a strong breeze. Tomas lifts the kite and Lola holds the line. A gust catches the wide silk face immediately. The kite tugs hard against Tomas hands, leaping upward like a living thing. Tomas laughs with surprise.'>>

choices.label: Let out more string to go higher
Steady the kite and watch it settle

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Lola ties a long ribbon tail to the diamond kite from her scrap bag. The ribbon is striped red and white. Tomas carries the kite outside and the breeze lifts it immediately. The ribbon snakes behind in the air, keeping the big kite steady even when the wind buffets sideways. Tomas cheers.'>>

choices.label: Test how high it can fly
Try flying over the garden

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas dips a brush in red paint and draws racing stripes along the box kite sides. Lola adds a blue lightning bolt. The paint dries quickly in the sun. choices.label: Launch Flash Arrow now
Add a second coat of paint

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='In the yard the box kite catches the wind and buzzes upward like a dragonfly. It darts left and right when Tomas tugs the line. choices.label: Try a loop-the-loop trick
Fly it beyond the fence

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='The diamond kite climbs fast as Tomas feeds out the string. Suddenly the wind shifts direction and the kite shudders. choices.label: Pull in the string and land it
Run with the wind to steady it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Tomas keeps the string tight and feels the diamond kite tug gently. The wind smooths into a steady hum. choices.label: Let the kite ride the steady wind
Bring it down and add a tail

choices.label: Pump the string to catch a breeze

choices.label: Keep flying over the garden

choices.label: Reel in fast to reset it
Slack the line and let it settle
